title: Native Pixie/Direct2D loading splash before WebView2 startup

decisions.text: Use Pixie's framework-agnostic D2D core only: Pixie.Canvas, Pixie.Canvas.D2D, Pixie.DrawingCanvas, Pixie.D2DHeaders, Pixie.Types, Pixie.WebColor, Pixie.Borders, Pixie.GradientLayer, Pixie.FontDescription (+ transitive units found in the spike). Exclude all *.VCL.*, *.FMX.*, *.Cairo.*, *ControlBase*, and HTML/SVG/Markdown units unless needed.

Splash is a native Win32 frameless top-level window drawn with Pixie D2D (ID2D1DCRenderTarget.BindDC on the window DC), created and shown BEFORE webview_create so it appears instantly, decoupled from WebView2 init.

Vendoring follows the repo convention (uos in SoundCore): Pixie lives in a git-ignored shared vendors\pixie fetched by a provision script in the AppCore repo; NO third-party sources/binaries committed. Only source search paths are added to build/win_x64/fpc-x64.cfg.
Localization reuses the SplashLang cfg key (ru default / en); status labels mirror the current splash phases.
Process: plan + ledger; per-step atomic commits (step-id prefixed); NO push; approval gate (PS0.3) before vendoring/implementation; visual launch is a manual gate.

OPEN (PS0.3): (a) provisioning method — shared ..\vendors\pixie + script (default) vs git subtree; (b) retire the in-WebView HTML splash vs keep it as a fallback; (c) splash visuals — spinner + step checklist (mirrors today) vs minimal logo+status.

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger written
evidence: Pixie identified as the FPC/Delphi HTML/graphics engine at EchoScript/EchoRecorder/vendors/pixie (NOT the Nim library).

Static feasibility: Pixie.Canvas.D2D.pas uses only Windows, ActiveX, SysUtils, Classes, Math, Generics.Collections + Pixie.* (no LCL/VCL/FMX/Graphics). Base Pixie.Canvas.pas uses only Classes, Generics.Collections. TPixieD2DCanvas renders to an HDC via ID2D1DCRenderTarget.BindDC (and offscreen via CreateWicBitmapRenderTarget). => usable from plain FPC + WinAPI, no Lazarus.

steps.title: Feasibility spike: compile minimal Pixie D2D under plain FPC + render to a frameless window
steps.verify: the minimal Pixie D2D unit set compiles with AppCore's fpc-x64.cfg (no LCL on the search path); a frameless test window shows Pixie-drawn text via BindDC; the window appears effectively instantly (<< WebView2 init).

steps.title: Approval gate (PS-D6)
steps.verify: owner confirms PS-D6 (a) provisioning method, (b) retire-vs-keep HTML splash, (c) splash visuals. PAUSE before PS1.1.

steps.title: Provision Pixie into git-ignored vendors + add source paths to fpc-x64.cfg
steps.verify: vendors\pixie present and git-ignored; provision script committed; fpc-x64.cfg has the minimal Pixie source paths; unit set documented in the plan.

steps.title: AppMain still builds with Pixie on the search path
steps.verify: build_app.bat succeeds with the Pixie paths added; no regression in the current app.

steps.title: AppSplash.pas — frameless top-level splash window
steps.verify: a borderless rectangular window is created, shown centered, and destroyed cleanly; no taskbar button; created in << WebView2 init time.

steps.title: Pixie D2D rendering + splashSetPhase API (localized)
steps.verify: background, app title, and a step line/checklist are drawn with Pixie via BindDC; splashSetPhase(text) updates the drawn status; ru/en per SplashLang.

steps.title: Animation + thread-safe status updates
steps.verify: WM_TIMER-driven spinner animates; status set from the startup worker thread is rendered without races or flicker.

steps.title: Per-monitor DPI for the splash
steps.verify: splash size/text scale by the target monitor DPI (PMv2); centered correctly on high-DPI / multi-monitor.

steps.title: Reorder startup: native splash first, WebView2 in background, swap on ready
steps.verify: splash shows before webview_create; startServices + WebView2 run in the worker; status pushed to the splash; on port-ready the WebView2 window is shown and the splash destroyed; no blank-window gap.

steps.title: Retire (or flag) the in-WebView HTML splash
steps.verify: the HTML splash is removed or gated; only the native splash is shown pre-ready.

steps.title: Build, deploy, visual gate
steps.verify: AppMain builds; deployed to SoundTrainer + MindWaveCore; owner confirms visually: instant splash, advancing status, clean swap to the UI.

steps.title: STATUS/docs update + final commit
steps.verify: ledger marked complete; docs reflect the native splash; final commit made.
